title: Wrap go_ioutil_reader functions in a FileReader struct
description: Brownfield Go refactor: introduce a FileReader struct that wraps the existing package-level file functions as methods.

task_spec.prompt:
Refactor internal/fileutil/fileutil.go to introduce a FileReader struct. All 3 existing tests must still pass.

Add to fileutil.go:

  type FileReader struct { /* unexported path field */ }

  func NewFileReader(path string) *FileReader
    — constructs a FileReader for the given path

  func (fr *FileReader) ReadBytes() ([]byte, error)
    — delegates to the package-level ReadBytes(fr.path)

  func (fr *FileReader) WriteBytes(data []byte) error
    — delegates to the package-level WriteBytes(fr.path, data)

  func (fr *FileReader) ReadLines() ([]string, error)
    — delegates to the package-level ReadLines(fr.path)

Also add tests for the FileReader methods in fileutil_test.go.
Do not modify the existing package-level functions.
All 3 existing tests must still pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: FileReader struct with unexported path field
Tests for FileReader methods added to fileutil_test.go
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `go test ./...` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
